title: Mobility Equipment Patient Agreement Clause — First-Month Purchase Option
content:
# First-Month Purchase Option — Mobility Equipment

**Clause 1 — The offer.** On a Mobility Equipment class whose first-month purchase option is yes, Summit Ridge offers the patient at delivery the choice to buy the chair outright instead of renting; only the patient can make the election.

**Clause 2 — The election window.** The purchase election is received no later than the class's purchase election window, in days, after the chair is delivered, counting calendar days from the day after the delivery date with the boundary day included; a later request is refused and the rental continues to the cap. The delivery date is read from the system's wheelchair record of this chair.

**Clause 3 — Billing on election.** On election the chair is billed once as a purchase (modifier NU) at the class's fee-schedule purchase amount multiplied by the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule and divided by 100, rounded to the cent half up, with the first day of service the delivery date, and a rental month 1 already paid is reversed by the payer with the reversal reason purchase conversion.

**Clause 4 — Classes without the option.** Classes without the option are never sold outright to coverage.

## The window on the calendar (hypothetical, 30-day window)

| Delivery date | Day 1 of the count | Last day the election is received in time | Election received | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 2 March | 31 March | 31 March | in time — the boundary day is included |
| 1 March | 2 March | 31 March | 1 April | refused; the rental continues to the cap |

## Purchase amount (hypothetical allowed percentage of 80)

For a Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856), 8977.60 multiplied by 80 and divided by 100 is 7182.08, billed once with modifier NU.

## Points of judgement

- **Who may elect?** Only the patient.
- **What happens to a month 1 already paid?** The payer reverses it, with the reason purchase conversion.
